title: A bearer-token middleware by hand
summary: Parse the Authorization header, validate the JWT, set HttpContext.User, and answer 401 and 403 correctly.

steps.title: The Authorization header
body: A client sends an access token like this (RFC 6750):
The scheme name is case-insensitive (`bearer` is fine), followed by one space and the token. On the server:
When authentication fails, answer `401` with a `WWW-Authenticate` header that names the scheme, and say why when a token *was* sent:
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"   (bad, expired, wrong audience)
And never log the token itself. It's a password with an expiry date.

steps.title: Middleware that sets HttpContext.User
body: The middleware's job is only **authentication**: work out who is calling and record it. Endpoints (or policies) do the authorization.
if (principal is null)                 // ...and it was bad: stop here
await next(ctx);                           // no header: carry on as anonymous
Rejecting a *bad* token even on a public endpoint is a deliberate choice: a client sending a broken token deserves to hear about it rather than silently getting anonymous results.

steps.prompt: Why does the middleware `return` without calling `next` when the token is invalid?
options: To short-circuit the pipeline so no endpoint runs for a request with a bad credential
To make the response faster to cache
It shouldn't; it should call `next` and let the endpoint decide

steps.title: Bearer middleware
prompt: The starter has `TokenValidator.ValidatePayload(token, now)` (alg, signature with key `aspnet-demo-signing-key-0123456789ab`, `exp`, `iss` `https://auth.dojo`, `aud` `tasks-api`), returning the payload JSON or `null`, and your `ToPrincipal` from the last lesson. **Run checks** starts the server and calls it with tokens it signs itself.

1. Middleware: if an `Authorization` header is present, it must be `Bearer <token>` (any case) with a valid token, else answer `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"` and stop. Valid -> set `ctx.User`. No header -> continue anonymously. Pass `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()` as `now`.

static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("Anonymous requests could be checked", async () =>
Dojo.Eq("GET /public works without a token", "hello", await DojoWeb.Text(await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/public", null)));
var me = await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", null);
DojoWeb.Status("GET /me without a token gets 401", 401, me);
Dojo.Check("with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer", DojoAuth.Challenge(me).StartsWith("Bearer"), "header was: " + DojoAuth.Challenge(me));
await Dojo.TryAsync("Bad tokens could be checked", async () =>
DojoWeb.Status("a garbage token gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", "garbage"));

DojoWeb.Status("a token signed with another key gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", DojoAuth.Sign("{\"iss\":\"https://auth.dojo\",\"aud\":\"tasks-api\",\"sub\":\"ada\",\"exp\":4102444800}", "not-the-key-not-the-key-not-the-key")));
var expired = await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", DojoAuth.For("ada", exp: 1000000000));
DojoWeb.Status("an expired token gets 401", 401, expired);
Dojo.Check("with error=\"invalid_token\"", DojoAuth.Challenge(expired).Contains("invalid_token"), "header was: " + DojoAuth.Challenge(expired));

DojoWeb.Status("a token for another audience gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", DojoAuth.Sign("{\"iss\":\"https://auth.dojo\",\"aud\":\"billing-api\",\"sub\":\"ada\",\"exp\":4102444800}")));
DojoWeb.Status("alg none gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", "eyJhbGciOiJub25lIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiJ9."));
DojoWeb.Status("a non-Bearer scheme gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", DojoAuth.For("ada"), "Basic"));
DojoWeb.Status("even on a public endpoint, a bad token gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/public", "garbage"));
await Dojo.TryAsync("Good tokens could be checked", async () =>
var me = await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", DojoAuth.For("ada", "[\"user\"]"));
DojoWeb.Status("GET /me with a good token gets 200", 200, me);
Dojo.Eq("and returns sub", "ada", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(me), "sub"));
DojoWeb.Status("a lower-case 'bearer' scheme works too", 200, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", DojoAuth.For("ada"), "bearer"));
DojoWeb.Status("DELETE /admin/tasks/1 anonymously gets 401", 401, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Delete, "/admin/tasks/1", null));
DojoWeb.Status("DELETE /admin/tasks/1 as a user gets 403", 403, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Delete, "/admin/tasks/1", DojoAuth.For("ada", "[\"user\"]")));
DojoWeb.Status("DELETE /admin/tasks/1 as an admin gets 204", 204, await DojoAuth.Send(http, HttpMethod.Delete, "/admin/tasks/1", DojoAuth.For("root", "[\"user\",\"admin\"]")));
static class DojoAuth
static string B64(byte[] d) => Convert.ToBase64String(d).TrimEnd('=').Replace('+', '-').Replace('/', '_');
static string B64(string s) => B64(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s));
public static string Sign(string payload, string? key = null, string header = "{\"alg\":\"HS256\",\"typ\":\"JWT\"}")
var input = B64(header) + "." + B64(payload);
var k = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key ?? "aspnet-demo-signing-key-0123456789ab");
return input + "." + B64(System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256.HashData(k, System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(input)));
// A valid token for tasks-api that expires in 2100.
public static string For(string sub, string roles = "[]", string scope = "", long exp = 4102444800) =>
Sign("{\"iss\":\"https://auth.dojo\",\"aud\":\"tasks-api\",\"sub\":\"" + sub + "\",\"role\":" + roles + ",\"scope\":\"" + scope + "\",\"exp\":" + exp + "}");
public static Task<HttpResponseMessage> Send(HttpClient http, HttpMethod method, string url, string? token, string scheme = "Bearer")
var msg = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url);
if (token is not null) msg.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Authorization", scheme + " " + token);
return http.SendAsync(msg);
public static string Challenge(HttpResponseMessage r) =>
r.Headers.WwwAuthenticate.Count > 0 ? string.Join(",", r.Headers.WwwAuthenticate) : "";
